title: What Comes After Games
coreMove: Use awareness, spontaneity, and intimacy as direction markers without turning them into new practices or performances.
sourcePressure: Closes with autonomy as the capacity to live without games, constituted by awareness, spontaneity, and intimacy, while naming their failure modes and rarity.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning autonomy into a life-coach technique, a mindfulness routine, or permanent independence from other people.

sourceAnchors.name: autonomy triad
sourceAnchors.detail: the source defines autonomy through awareness, spontaneity, and intimacy as what remains when games fall away
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Autonomy is not being alone; it is needing fewer hidden structures to make contact possible.

sourceAnchors.name: awareness
sourceAnchors.detail: the source defines awareness as perceiving directly in the present rather than through Parent programming or Child reaction
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Awareness is the pause where the old response becomes visible before it becomes inevitable.

sourceAnchors.name: intimacy
sourceAnchors.detail: the source defines intimacy as direct, game-free contact and notes that it is rare because it requires both people to be free of their patterns at once
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Intimacy is rare because one person cannot produce it alone.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: editorial meeting where an old defensive line appears
exampleSpecs.audience: a magazine editor catching awareness before the sentence delivers itself
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team can either hear current facts or another old status move
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Audrey sees the prepared line form, waits one breath, and asks what changed in the draft instead.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 9:06 a.m., Audrey feels the sentence arrive before her mouth moves.

exampleSpecs.domain: adult piano lesson after years of apologizing before mistakes
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner finding spontaneity by accessing a playful Child state instead of his usual shame script
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice can open range or confirm limitation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Antoine laughs at the wrong note and tries the bar again from curiosity rather than apology.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The wrong note rings brighter than the right ones in the small studio.

exampleSpecs.domain: friendship conversation after a missed birthday
exampleSpecs.audience: a friend testing whether contact can happen without prosecuting or performing injury
exampleSpecs.stakes: a close friendship may leave the familiar grievance track for one clean exchange
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Marta says the hurt plainly and stops before adding the line that would make the other person pay.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "I was hurt, and I do not want to make a case out of it," Marta says.

exampleSpecs.domain: firehouse debrief after a call went badly
exampleSpecs.audience: a captain allowing Adult fact and genuine Child fear without collapsing into command voice
exampleSpecs.stakes: safety learning depends on range, not forced toughness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Jack moves from data to fear to next procedure without pretending one state cancels the others.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Soot dries in the creases of every hand around the debrief table.

exampleSpecs.domain: first date after recognizing old performance habits
exampleSpecs.audience: a person seeing that charm can become a game even when nothing cruel is intended
exampleSpecs.stakes: a possible connection can stay direct or become a performance of being easy to like
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chloe lets one quiet answer stand instead of filling the silence with her reliable entertaining story.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You know the story that always works before the waiter takes the glasses away.

exampleSpecs.domain: adult siblings sorting a parent's storage unit
exampleSpecs.audience: two people finding a brief game-free hour inside a grief-heavy task
exampleSpecs.stakes: intimacy requires both to drop the old roles at once, however briefly
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Kiran sees later that neither sibling prepared a defense while the other held the photograph, which made the hour different.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Only later does Kiran understand why the storage unit felt quiet instead of loaded.

skillTargets: define autonomy as living without games
explain why intimacy requires two people simultaneously free of patterns

tryThisNowSpec: In one conversation today, notice the prepared line before saying it. Let one breath pass. Then answer only what is actually present.
